Where yesterday’s tales create today’s stories
Set within eleven acres of private parkland just outside Edinburgh, Dalhousie Castle has stood for over 800 years. Following an extensive refurbishment, the castle enters a new chapter, offering beautifully appointed bedrooms, exceptional dining and warm Scottish hospitality, all while preserving the history and character that have defined it for centuries.
Dine in one of our unique restaurant spaces, explore the castle’s fascinating history, celebrate a special occasion or simply unwind and enjoy the story of your surroundings at one of Scotland’s oldest inhabited castles.
